* The values change per {{M|channeling}} {{M|server tick}}, over {{#expr:trunc({{#var:Tame the Beasts value1}}/{{G|tick rate}})}} instances.
** {{Symbol|a|up}}
*** The total {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} is defined as:
**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Σ[[Spell Damage|SpellDmg]] {{=}} MinDmg × 2 ^ ([[Server Tick|CurrentTick]] / {{#expr:trunc({{#var:Tame the Beasts value1}}/{{G|tick rate}})/2}})}}
*** The {{Code|1x}} {{to}} {{Code|2x}} {{to}} {{Code|3x}} {{to}} {{Code|4x}} ability effects above Ringmaster appear as follows per n<sup>th</sup> channeling intervals:
**** 2nd ({{Code|{{#expr:{{G|tick rate}}*2 round3}}s}}) {{to}} 15th ({{Code|{{#expr:{{G|tick rate}}*15 round3}}s}}) {{to}} 23rd ({{Code|{{#expr:{{G|tick rate}}*23 round3}}s}}) {{to}} 29th  ({{Code|{{#expr:{{G|tick rate}}*29 round3}}s}}).
*** The {{M|caster-fear}} duration increases linearly per channel instance.
** {{Symbol|a|down}}
*** The effect radius reduces linearly by per channel instance.
*** The outer area-targeting reticule becomes smaller correspondingly to the {{M|channeling}} time, visible ally-only.

* The following conditions proc the current ability cast:
** Either upon reaching the max {{M|channeling}} time, or being interrupted by any {{M|disable}} sources.
** Upon Ringmaster's {{M|death}}.
** The {{A|Ringmaster|Crack}} {{M|sub-ability}} cast.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** {{#var:Tame the Beasts value2}} seconds after the {{M|channeling}} ends, applies all ability effects within the radius immediately regardless of the ability visual effects.
** The effects applied do not utilize {{M|projectiles|x}}. Hence, all ability effects are still applied even upon Ringmaster's {{M|death|x}}.
** {{cf|talnotes}} {{M|Pure}} damage instances affect the self {{M|debuff immunity}} granted while channeling.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The {{M|caster-fear}} causes the affected enemy to run {{M|Facing Angle|text=facing away}} from Ringmaster.
** Reapplying the fear {{M|debuff}} refreshes its duration.
** [[Movement Speed#Set Movement Speed|Sets]] the fear-affected hero's current movement speed as its base movement speed.
** Grants the affected enemy {{M|phase movement}}.
** Affects the following units:
*** {{M|Fogged units}}.
*** {{M|Invisible}} units.

[[File:Dota2 Ringmaster Souvenir HUD.png|300px|thumb|Custom HUD element listing the souvenirs, available by clicking on the [[File:Dota2 Ringmaster Souvenir Ticket icon.png|24px]] ticket icon]]

* The Souvenir pseudo-item abilities are in the {{Spellslot|4|6}}.

* Grants charges for the following pseudo-item abilities, with its current charges displayed on Ringmaster's [[HUD]]:
** {{A|Ringmaster|Funhouse Mirror}}
** {{A|Ringmaster|Whoopee Cushion}}
** {{A|Ringmaster|Strongman Tonic}}
** {{A|Ringmaster|Unicycle}}
** The first granted ability of the next cycle cannot be the same as last granted ability of the previous cycle.

* The aformentioned abilities have the following properties:
** Affected by {{M|mute}} sources, but not {{M|silence}} sources.
** Grants a random ability charge on the first enemy hero death.
** Does not grant the same ability twice in a row.
** The current charges are visible to allies only.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# Reduces the current charges by 1 upon a souvenir ability cast.
*# Grants a random souvenir, with its corresponding icon displayed above Ringmaster's head upon proc.  
*# The new granted ability goes on a 3-second shared {{M|cooldown}}.

* Grants a charge in the following {{M|on-death effects}}:
** Upon the enemy hero's {{M|death}}, including from {{M|denies}}, within the death radius.
** Considers the {{H|Spirit Bear}} and {{A|Meepo|Divided We Stand|text=Meepo Clones}} as heroes; {{M|illusions}}, {{M|The Double}} and other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
** Ringmaster has to be credited for the kill to gain charges outside the death radius, excluding Ringmaster's {{M|Summons|text=player-controlled units}}.

* Does not grant charges in the following conditions:
** Killing an allied hero.
** From {{M|reincarnation}} sources.
** Dying without a Souvenir to {{M|Neutral Creeps}} or {{M|Roshan}}.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_ringmaster
data.bio_loc:
Welcome, welcome, one and all — to a stage-lit extravaganza for the ages! Prepare to have your senses shattered! Your expectations demolished! Your Ancients smashed to ruins!

Witness the impossible feats and derring-do of the one and only clockwork marvel, the Great Cogliostro Kettle — Ringmaster, torture artist, genius in his own time — here now for the sole agony and entertainment of any hero bold enough to draw back the crimson carnival curtain and behold what mysteries await inside.

The mistake most maestros make is waiting for the public to come to them. The Ringmaster knows you need to go out and find your audience! Drag them to you. And make them watch.
data.hype_loc: All the battlefield's a stage, and Ringmaster is a gleeful director. Controlling fights with a showman's flair, Ringmaster tames enemies with his fearsome whip and endless knives, ushers allies away from danger with his cunning escape act, and always draws a crowd to unwillingly witness the wonders of his mesmerizing wheel.
data.npe_desc_loc: Directs the battle with fear and mesmerism

abilities.name: ringmaster_tame_the_beasts
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to %abilitychanneltime% second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.
abilities.lore_loc: From unhappy crowds to unruly acts, nothing persuades a pack of animals quite like the crack of the Ringmaster's whip.

abilities.name: ringmaster_the_box
abilities.desc_loc: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
abilities.lore_loc: An adept assistant has nothing to fear within the confines of The Box. An amateur has...much darker prospects indeed.
abilities.scepter_loc: Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

abilities.name: ringmaster_impalement
abilities.desc_loc: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.
abilities.lore_loc: Passed down through generations, it simply wouldn't be a Kettle Circus without the Great Cogliostro's signature trick.

abilities.name: ringmaster_spotlight
abilities.desc_loc: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.
abilities.lore_loc: Are you ready for your fifteen seconds? The limelight draws no distinction between infamy and fame.

abilities.name: ringmaster_wheel
abilities.desc_loc:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: No, brave friends, illusions are for charlatans and card sharks. What you witness today is the power of true magic. But only if you dare set your gaze upon...the mesmerizing wheel.

abilities.name: ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs
abilities.desc_loc:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.
facets_loc: Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Funhouse Mirror, Strongman Tonic, and Whoopee Cushion.
Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Crystal Ball, Unicycle, and Weighted Pie.

abilities.name: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
abilities.desc_loc:
Use: Proportion Distortion

Creates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
notes_loc: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.

abilities.name: ringmaster_strongman_tonic
abilities.desc_loc:
Use: Forcefully Imbibe

Temporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by %strength_bonus_base% plus %strength_bonus_per_level% per Ringmaster's level for %duration% seconds. The effect holds for %effect_strength_max_duration% seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

abilities.name: ringmaster_whoopee_cushion
abilities.desc_loc:
Use: Whoopsie

Propels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.

abilities.name: ringmaster_summon_unicycle
abilities.desc_loc:
Use: Saddle Up

Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.
